definition: Count of distinct order IDs in the order model.
population_denominator: All orders in the historical dataset.
interpretation: Overall order volume; not a count of completed sales.

definition: Orders whose recorded status is delivered.
interpretation: Status count; a subset can fail delivery-metric eligibility because dates are missing or invalid.

definition: Canceled orders divided by all orders.
interpretation: Describes recorded cancellations, not the reason or preventability.

definition: Unavailable orders divided by all orders.
Delivered orders with valid purchase, actual-delivery and estimated-delivery calendar dates.
Eligible delivered orders where actual delivery date is after estimated delivery date.
interpretation: Number of delayed orders in the measured population.

definition: Late eligible delivered orders divided by all eligible delivered orders.
interpretation: Conditional on delivery being recorded; do not interpret as a late rate for all orders placed.

definition: Eligible delivered orders received on or before the estimated calendar date divided by eligible delivered orders.
Median calendar days from purchase date to actual delivery date.
interpretation: Describes typical wait; different from lateness against the promise.

definition: Median actual delivery date minus estimated delivery date, restricted to positive delays.
interpretation: Early deliveries do not offset the size of late delays.

definition: Mean of order-level average review scores.
population_denominator: 98,673 orders with one or more numeric review scores.
interpretation: Each order gets equal weight after its own reviews are averaged.

definition: Orders with an order-level mean score <= 2, divided by orders with scores.
interpretation: An explicit portfolio definition; document it in the dashboard.

definition: Mean order-level review score among eligible late orders with a score.
interpretation: Descriptive association; not proof of causality.

definition: Mean order-level review score among eligible on-time/early orders with a score.
interpretation: Compare using the same scoring method as late orders.

definition: Mean on-time/early score minus mean late-order score.
population_denominator: Reviewed eligible delivered orders, summarized at order level.
interpretation: A positive gap shows lower scores in the late group; unadjusted for other factors.

definition: Share of reviewed late orders with order-level mean review score <= 2.
interpretation: Helps quantify customer experience among late deliveries.

definition: Share of reviewed on-time/early orders with order-level mean review score <= 2.
interpretation: Comparison group for the low-rating share.

definition: Sum of item price totals among eligible delivered orders with item data; excludes freight.
population_denominator: 96,470 eligible delivered orders with item data.
interpretation: Merchandise value only; not profit and not net revenue.

kpi: Average item price per eligible delivered order (BRL)
definition: Delivered item-price total divided by eligible delivered orders with item data.
population_denominator: 96,470 eligible delivered orders with item data.
interpretation: Excludes freight and is not an accounting AOV unless the definition is adopted.
